title: My Portfolio
description: A modern and fully responsive personal portfolio built with Next.js, TailwindCSS, and Framer Motion. Designed to showcase projects, skills, and experience with a clean dark theme and smooth animations.

title: GAM
description: A bespoke e‑commerce experience for a luxury footwear brand, designed to read more like a dark, cinematic editorial than a traditional storefront. Every detail — from the dual‑theme system and phone‑OTP checkout to the Telegram‑driven order management — was built to feel intentional, not templated. Vibe coded with Claude Code. Freelance project, live and in production.

title: Productivity Hub
description: A full-stack productivity platform built with Next.js, Supabase, and OpenAI that unifies bookmarks, task and note management, AI chat, personalized insights, and role-based admin tools in one polished workspace.

title: Tech Pulse
description: TechPulse Daily is a multilingual tech-news aggregation app built with Next.js App Router. It crawls major technology publications server-side, and presents readable articles with source metadata, inline media, market widgets, and AI-assisted summaries. I vibe-coded this project with GPT-5.3-Codex.

title: Gym Management System
description: A vide coded comprehensive gym management system built for users to find their ideal gym, and for gym owners to manage their gyms. The platform includes features such as membership management, income insights and an admin panel for gym owners to oversee operations.

title: Naghz-mvp
description: Naghz is a learning assistant that helps you learn essential life and soft skills through real-time, interactive guidance and this is the MVP version of the project that we are working on it.

title: 100bestmovies English learning
